deliverable.physical_OFF: Existing SDK owner sets camera and audio native sources/pipeline to NULL; native-source metadata/quiescence ACK, not only muted consumer or closed valve; no pixels/PCM retained.
deliverable.STOP: Persisted shared negative state checked during current run and SDK startup; manual STOP scope explicitly camera+audio+conversation; never relabel historical audio-only STOP as camera-off.
deliverable.current_state: Panel shows acknowledged OFF/ON/transition/UNKNOWN and scope; missing/stale/replaced owner is UNKNOWN, never inferred OFF/ON from requested flag.
deliverable.return: Fresh explicit operator action bound to current mode/policy/intent/SDK owner; respects latest privacy/quiet/MIC/motion negatives and STOP; no auto-resume after restart.
deliverable.PC: Untouched original runtime, model, profile, resources, and databases. No model/ASR/Alice windows.

execution_guards: No production action before new PM GO with actual start and immutable deadlines.

Before first mutation freeze full executable transaction and each partial fallback, exact current parents/preimages and local stage manifest/native imports. These are inside the whole, not a prerequisite adapter project.
Use original SDK owner; no new hardware driver/owner, tap, vision/sourceclock work, frame/model/source-freshness window, resource/provider/profile changes.
One native manual control sequence; first actual unexpected negative or missed FIRST ends attempt, no retry/reset/extension. Finish safe fallback/retention only.

Latest real manual/global denial wins over literal old-source rollback; retain necessary enforcement and fences if required until qualified current explicit return. Never clear UNKNOWN by restart or old snapshot.
Preserve U96 encoder-safe sole writer, latest mode/volume/AUTOoff, current owners/negative files, exact original parents and DB state.
No broad permission requests or user QA; no silent repeat of blocking filechooser/login.

browser_dependency.known: Existing-key login succeeded in old browser call; session persistence after turn cleanup has not been newly tested.
browser_dependency.if_unavailable: One narrow dependency: authenticated current Hub panel session for final UI proof. Reuse saved existing-key API/auth path if supported; no implicit renewed long filechooser. If unavailable within whole deadline, classify UI proof unavailable and close safely; no fabricated product PASS or extension.

fallback: Before each SDK/Agent/Hub mutation freeze exact selector/source/service partial inverse. Retire/drain known producers and maintain sole safe motor owner; restore exact original parents only when compatible with latest durable negative, otherwise keep required negative enforcement. Preserve newer human controls, no forcedON, no DB snapshot/oldRAM restore. Each failed partial must terminate with known retained state or honest UNKNOWN plus effective denial.
qualification_limits: Physical OFF plus persisted-deny/current explicit return is the useful target. This does not claim conversation quality, actual visual perception, power-cut proof, or prior source-clock failure repair.
